content:
Apple is expanding watchOS 27.0.1 to more Apple Watch models today, after the update was first made available for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 last week. Here are the details.

Apple Watch users can now install watchOS 27.0.1

Last week, Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 first for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, fixing an issue that could cause some devices to unexpectedly restart.

Today, Apple is pushing watchOS 27.0.1 to all other Apple Watch models compatible with watchOS 27, including:

  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3

Apple has not changed the release notes for watchOS 27.0.1, which still read:

In addition, the build number released today is also 24R365, the same as the build released last week for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Alongside watchOS 27.0.1, Apple also released iOS 27.0.1, iPadOS 27.0.1, visionOS 27.0.1, iOS 26.7.1, macOS 27.0.1 Golden Gate, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 today.

iOS 27.0.1 fixes an issue that could cause some iPhone 18 Pro models to restart when using Face ID; the other updates include additional bug fixes and security improvements.
